assumed.text: a food is raw if USDA's description says raw, unless it also says sausage, cured, salted, sugared, bockwurst, chorizo, added solution, enhanced

a food is prepared if it is in one of these SR Legacy groups: Snacks; Sweets; Baked Products; Fast Foods; Breakfast Cereals; Sausages and Luncheon Meats; Restaurant Foods; Meals, Entrees, and Side Dishes; Soups, Sauces, and Gravies; Branded Food Products Database
foods under 50 kcal per 100 g are left out of every count
the two beverage groups are left out, as the rules' authors left out liquids
fibre is taken as zero where SR Legacy has no value
SR Legacy, frozen in April 2018, stands for the US food supply
USDA's 'cooked, with salt' variants carry an imputed standard salt addition and are left out of the pairs
